messages:
maria: Morning — async standup for API gateway / routing / auth / rate limits
maria: what I did: rolled route adapter v2 to canary (us-west), fixed a header passthrough bug, ran perf sweep on prefix caching
maria: blockers: intermittent 429s on /v1/generate when batch_size=64 in dedicated pool; suspect batching config + KV cache eviction race
maria: today: add a circuit-breaker threshold, open PR, and finish integration test for prefix cache; pinging @alex for review
alex: on deck — will grab the PR after standup. do you have a repro flow or a snippet I can run locally?
maria: small repro script: 
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","batch_size":64}' https://gw.staging.redwood/api; done
```
maria: it surfaces after ~120 requests in my run
sam: saw similar in prod-ish load yesterday; added a quick logging patch that prints `cache.kv.evictions` on 429
sam: log excerpt:
```
WARN  runtime: request=192.168.5.12 route=/v1/generate tokens=1024 cache.evictions=3 status=429
```
sam: hypothesis: eviction causes stale KV references leading to retry storms from clients
jyoti: fyi i'm doing token rotation tonight; if we trigger retries maybe increase backoff client-side or enable graceful-fallback to smaller batch sizes
tasha: can we temporarily route heavy batch traffic to dedicated-low-latency pool until we patch? will that avoid customer impact?
alex: yes we can; I'll add a routing rule: if batch_size>=64 && route matches /v1/generate => pool=d-ll-01; will test canary
maria: thanks. i'll attach PR link when ready — https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/pulls/458 (WIP)
deploy-bot: canary deploy for gateway/adapter-v2 succeeded in us-west at 2468013720 :white_check_mark:
maria: nice — i'll watch metrics for next hour and update if noise subsides
alex: i'll review PR this afternoon; if ok i'll merge and roll to canary across regions
jyoti: i'll coordinate token rotation window to avoid overlap with the roll
tasha: alpha customers informed via #customer-success; they'll route any issues to us
maria: thanks team — ping here if you see 429 regressions; otherwise i'll post a short follow-up in ~1h with metric snapshot :wave:
